import importlib.util
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).parents[2]
SCRIPT = REPOSITORY / "scripts/check_architecture.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("check_architecture", SCRIPT)
architecture = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(architecture)


class ArchitecturePolicyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_repository_layout_passes(self):
        self.assertEqual([], architecture.check(REPOSITORY))

    def test_scanner_cli_passes(self):
        completed = subprocess.run(
            ["python3", str(SCRIPT), str(REPOSITORY)],
            cwd=REPOSITORY,
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, completed.returncode, completed.stderr)
        self.assertEqual("architecture: ok", completed.stdout.strip())

    def test_scanner_rejects_cross_contour_import(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            source = root / "internal/transport/http/private/router.go"
            source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            source.write_text(
                'package private\nimport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"\n',
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            errors = architecture.check(root)
            self.assertTrue(any("imports another HTTP contour" in error for error in errors), errors)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
